### Is Your Heart Open Before God?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-24-2024.html
Passage: Joshua 7:20-21
Points:
- Sin follows a clear progression that begins with seeing, develops into coveting, and leads to action.
- Outward wrongdoing originates in the heart before it ever manifests in physical conduct.
- Believers should confess sinful desires immediately rather than allowing ungodly thoughts to fester.
- Trying to bury transgression is foolish because private sin is never truly hidden from God.
- What believers attempt to hide God exposes, but what they openly confess God covers.

### Bible Pathway - Mar. 15, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-15-2010-11627482.html
Passage: Joshua 7:20-21
Points:
- Achan let selfish greed deceive him into assuming nobody would notice his disobedience.
- Coveting is a serious form of dishonesty that provokes God's righteous anger and judgment.
- Human nature is inherently selfish and vulnerable to temptation unless submitted to the Holy Spirit.
- Honesty in word and deed serves as a direct test of Christian character.
- Dealing deceitfully requires believers to repent, ask God for forgiveness, and restore what was taken.
